exercises.name: Leg Press
details: 3x8-10 (Medium weight, have half of your feet hanging off the bottom of the platform)

exercises.name: Leg Extensions
details: Single leg: 3x12-15 (Light weight, hold and slowly come down)

exercises.name: Single Hand Tricep Extension
details: 3x10-12 (Get a good squeeze at full extension)

exercises.name: Overhead Press or Dumbbell Skull Crushers
Bent Over Rows
details: 3x8-12 (Shoot for 12 on the first, then go up and get 10, then up again and get 8)
Keep your chest forward and your lower back arched. Pull your elbows back, not your shoulders up.

exercises.name: Wide Grip Lat Pulldowns
details: 3x12 (Medium weight, don't go all the way up, keep a little bend in your elbows between reps)

exercises.name: T-Bar Rows
details: 3x failure (HEAVY, fight for every rep, again pull your elbows back)
Alternative: Plate Loaded Chest Supported Row (same set count)

exercises.name: Rope Pullovers
details: 3x10-12 (Medium weight, slow controlled reps with full stretch)

exercises.name: Super Set Seated Incline Curls
details: Do one medium set then immediately one light set

exercises.name: Leg Press
details: 3x8-10 (Heavy weight, put the top of your toes at the top of the platform)

exercises.name: Hamstring Curls
details: Single leg: 3x10 (Light weight, SQUEEZE at the bottom)
